_comment: Hand resolution of the PDF damage that the automatic repairer cannot handle on its own. Regenerate with: node scripts/build-display.mjs mechonaut
_vocabulary_comment: Real words the corpus only ever shows in broken form, so the frequency-based vocabulary never learns them. Adding them here lets the ordinary repairer rejoin the fragments under the usual letters-unchanged guarantee — no text is hand-written for these.
_questions_comment: Where the PDF reordered or destroyed letters, repair is impossible without writing words, so the text is authored here and flagged. `reconstructed` marks the option letters that are no longer verbatim official text. `issue` marks a question the PDF damaged beyond recovery — the UI warns and the exam simulator skips it.
